what.text: This page follows refugees from El Salvador living in Mexico, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 19311 Salvadoran refugees in Mexico, 28.3% of all refugees from El Salvador.
The United States hosts the most Salvadoran refugees, followed by Mexico, Italy and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of El Salvador from 1979 to 1991, with the ERP, FPL and FMLN, at war level in most of those years.
The main years of displacement in the data, 1981 to 1988, fall within that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1980 at 44000 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 140000, at the end of 1981, and was much lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Mexico.
These are year-end totals for Mexico only, reported to UNHCR.
